what: Phone executor reads (exec.js hostOk) verify only the domain (breakoutprop.com), not WHICH Breakout account the terminal page is on. The device token pins the account server-side, but if the operator's login holds two accounts the positions/closes read could be another account's and be reconciled into breakout_2. Check whether the terminal URL's /account/<id>/ segment (Store.TERMINAL_URL) can be pinned per device in config/prop_phone_devices.yaml and refused on mismatch.
